summary: A mixed legal and retail day, dominated by Reliance Retail's strategic exit from 7-Eleven operations and a major IPO filing for Anmol. One high court rebuke on judicial process adds legal friction.

bullets.text: Reliance Retail and 7-Eleven ending five-year franchise partnership; nearly 60 stores shutting after failing to achieve profitability.
Trilegal, Khaitan & Co acting on Anmol's ₹1,800 crore proposed IPO.
Jio Platforms IPO likely by October end at enterprise valuation of $143–146 billion.
Nykaa expects net revenue growth in late twenties in Q2; fashion vertical expected to grow in early forties.
P&H High Court rapped Punjab government for attempting to challenge judgment through tweets in DA case.
